decisions_log.question: Fate of existing bikephysics/ and main.py
Config file format
decisions_log.decision: TOML for input, JSON for machine-written artifacts

decisions_log.question: CLI topology
decisions_log.decision: One `bike` entry point with subcommand groups (simplified/planar/opt/spec/validate)

decisions_log.question: Ground contact / integration strategy
decisions_log.decision: Regularized/penalty contact + stiff integrator (Radau) as default now; event-driven exact mode switching added later (T11) as a fidelity reference only

decisions_log.question: Lumped 2D drivetrain model (new physics)
decisions_log.decision: Option B: crankset as a real rigid body + one scalar chain-tension constraint (multiplier = chain tension); freewheel as a proper unilateral mode switch; PedalInput protocol with clipped-sine default

decisions_log.question: Optimization first-milestone approach
decisions_log.decision: Control parametrization + scipy for milestone 1 (T8); CasADi direct collocation for milestone 2 (T9)

decisions_log.question: Autodiff/NLP stack for optimization milestone 2+
decisions_log.decision: CasADi as an optional extra (`uv sync --extra opt`); core apps never require it

decisions_log.question: Sign-convention handling between tiers (z-down in Simplified vs z-up in 2D)
decisions_log.decision: Code: one named sign flip at the Simplified module's public boundary, each tier implemented in its own document's convention. LaTeX: left as-is, not re-signed.

decisions_log.question: Results persistence format
decisions_log.decision: result.npz + summary.json; revisit Parquet/HDF5 later if needed
